promptPrefix: Answer from this repository's documentation. Its index is docs/README.md. Name the exact identifiers, flags and values you find.

questions.question: When Kangentic starts the OpenAI coding agent, what does it pass so the agent never stops to offer installing a newer version of itself, and why does that offer matter?
Why must the per-launch MCP settings Kangentic hands the OpenAI coding agent contain no quote characters?
What happens to the per-folder trust record Kangentic adds to the OpenAI coding agent's config when a task's checkout is deleted, and why does that matter?
One agent files its session history under a folder named from a hash of the working directory. Which agent, which hash, and what is the file called?
How does Kangentic keep Claude Code's built-in side panel of file changes from opening next to the conversation?
Which agents can Kangentic check for a logged-out state before a session starts, and how does each one check?
When a user moves a project folder to a new place on disk, how do the agents' own records of the old path get updated?
When a task lands in a column, in what order does Kangentic decide which agent to start, and why is the agent that last ran the task left out of that decision?
Which agent can run against a server somewhere else instead of on the user's machine, and how does Kangentic check that the server is reachable?
Which agent does Kangentic use to suggest a short title for a new task, and at what moment is an automatic rename applied?
Which agent splits its hook commands into arguments itself instead of handing them to a shell, and how does Kangentic write those commands as a result?
How does Kangentic keep a task from looking idle while a build or test run that the agent started in the background is still going, and how can a long-lived dev server be let out of that?
Compare how Kangentic gets its own MCP server into the OpenAI coding agent, Google's Gemini CLI and Factory's Droid.
Which agents need a folder marked as trusted before they load hooks or MCP servers, and how does Kangentic handle that for each?
Which agents give Kangentic no hook events at all, and how does it tell when they are working or waiting?
What goes wrong when a path in an agent's hook command contains characters a shell would rewrite, and how does Kangentic quote paths for each agent's shell?
